title: RELX Infinity 2 Device
description:
RELX Infinity 2 Device Kit
The RELX Infinity 2 offers the ultimate vaping experience with adjustable power modes—Eco, Smooth, and Boost. It charges to 80% in just 15 minutes, has extended battery life, and features a battery indicator. Compatible with RELX Pods, it provides endless flavor options to keep your vaping fresh and exciting.

RELX Infinity 2 Key Features:
Battery Capacity:440 mAh
Pod Capacity: 2mL
1 Click to switch among 3-level modes (3-level modes ONLY work with RELX POD PRO 2):
Eco: 5.5W (light puff, battery saving)
Smooth: 6.5W (smooth / original touch)
Boost: 8W (satisfaction / richer taste / 15% more cloud)
Ultra Fast USB-C Charging
RELX Infinity 2 Specifications:
Output Power: 5.5 ~ 8 W
Battery Capacity: 440 mAh
Battery Indicator: Yes

Package Contents
1x RELX Infinity 2 Device
1x USB-C Cable
1x User Manual
Pods are not included in the package
